q1_what_did_you_play: I played Dodoco Blast for its guaranteed 7 damage to all enemies, then played Kaboom! on Twig Slime (S) to finish it after Dodoco Blast reduced it to 2 HP, and finally played Duck and Cover for 5 Block. This used the 2 available Sparks and 2 of 3 Energy, leaving 1 Energy unused because no other playable card remained.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up the chance to play Bang Bang! instead of Dodoco Blast, since both spend the same 2 Sparks and only one could be played. It also left 1 Energy unused, but there was no remaining card that could spend it.
q4_different_intent: No. The chosen line was driven mainly by resource use, guaranteed damage, killing the lowest-HP attacker, and gaining Block. A different telegraphed intent would not have made another affordable line clearly better, because Dodoco Blast plus Kaboom! plus Duck and Cover still provided the strongest guaranteed damage and the only Block available.
